summary: Short steep dead-end kerb beside apartment blocks; too steep and too close to homes.
reasons: Narrow street, little room off lane

drivers.seclusion: Ellenmac apartments 7 m from the kerb at 9 m; Paragon Crest 15 m; detached houses about 24 m at the north end.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street with kerb and grass strip; no wide pull-off. Reachable from the cross street.
drivers.traffic: Quiet dead-end style residential street; low traffic.
drivers.convention: No cars seen parked on this stretch; a few park in the apartment driveway opposite.

flags: Steep: mean 17.8%, max 26.2%, over the 12% limit
Apartments within 10 m of the kerb
sun_shade: Tree canopy shades the west side and road; building shades the east kerb in the afternoon.

best_section.where: Northern end of Lucinda Street, east kerb, past the apartment block
